name: Block Condition Published
description: Block visibility condition on published status.
project_description:
A module that provides a condition plugin for blocks. Allows to display block on pages depending on publishing status of the content. For example, a block can be shown for editors on unpublished pages only.

 Features 
 Supports both classic Published/Unpublished status and workflows ( Review, Draft... etc.) as well. In case of workflows, all states such as Draft, Unpublished, Review... are treated as unpublished, state Published is treated as published content.

 Node entity type is supported.

 Taxonomy term published state is supported since 1.0.0-beta1 release.

 Post-Installation 
 Go to your website's block layout settings, choose a block you want and set condition Published State for it.

 Additional Requirements 
 None.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 N/A.
